why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Read the homepage Open credible.finance to see the eight verticals Credible serves and how its payments flow works. The coverage page lists the markets it supports.
2 Step 2 : Open the app Go to the Credible app , which shows a demo view until you connect your wallet.
3 Step 3 : Create an account Use the sign-up link on the docs login page ( sign-up page ) to create an account, then connect your business and preview the product.
4 Step 4 : Complete KYB The homepage lists asynchronous business verification as the next stage: you upload documents and wait for review.

5 Step 5 : Read the docs The docs open on a login page with a sign-up link. The homepage says that after self-onboarding and KYB, a business authenticates and calls the payments, payouts and ledger endpoints.
